input.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds Customer anywhere in the Agreement. Clause 12.3 affirmatively preserves our freedom to develop, acquire or license any product or service and to engage any supplier, and expressly records that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, minimum-volume or no-hire commitment; clause 2.1 confirms there is no minimum quantity or purchase commitment and that declining to place further Order Forms is not a breach. The only exclusivity-flavoured restriction (clause 12.4, barring Vendor from marketing a directly competing analytics service) runs against Vendor and benefits us, so it is not flagged. This meets the preferred position.
